m-175.translation: Because it's not abstract enough to fit in.

m-174.translation: These days, you have to hustle no matter what you do.

m-173.translation: Of course, this trip home is really packed with tasks.

errors.note: “包的”是口语化表示“没问题/当然/包在我身上”，译成“Of course”改变了语气，且与后文“任务满满”的语义衔接生硬，属于误译。
“任务满满”译成“packed with tasks”偏书面、生硬，不像字幕口语，可用“full of things to do”等更自然表达。

m-172.translation: Abstracted to this extent, I've got to extract it and post it on Moments.

errors.note: “抽象”是网络俚语，指某人行为离谱、怪异，并非“abstracted”（心不在焉）之意，此处误译。
“抽出来”指把这个人揪出来/拉出来，不是“extract”（提取）的意思。
“朋友圈”是微信的“Moments”，但未加限定可能让不熟悉微信的观众困惑；可接受但略欠清晰。

m-176.translation: Teammate said he really wasn't cheating.

m-177.translation: The brat threw toys everywhere and said, "Who cares?"

errors.note: “把玩具扔得到处都是”强调扔的动作造成散落一地的结果，译文“threw toys everywhere”更接近“到处扔玩具”，结果状态略弱，但基本可接受。

m-181.translation: Why did you change your WeChat nickname to this?

m-182.translation: So relatable—a classic modern-day social death moment.

m-178.translation: Can you stop being so abstract?

m-179.translation: Actually, Louis XVI could still make another sum of money, because the old head can be recycled on the Zhuanzhuan app.

errors.note: “旧首级”指路易十六被斩下的旧头颅，译文“the old head”过于字面且歧义，易被理解为普通旧脑袋，未传达“被砍下的首级”之意。

errors.span: the old head can be recycled
errors.note: “recycled”偏正式/环保术语，字幕口语中“回收”用在此处略显生硬，可更口语化。

m-184.translation: Why are you still awake at 3 a.m. on your side?

m-180.translation: I see everyone in the group is spreading this.

errors.note: “我看”在此处是“我注意到/听说”的意思，译成“I see”偏向字面直译，语气略生硬。

errors.span: everyone in the group is spreading this
errors.note: “都在传”指大家纷纷转发/议论，译成“is spreading this”略显生硬，不够口语化。

m-187.translation: So what? It's me every year—you don't mind, do you?

m-190.translation: Fun fact: WeChat stickers can't be sent repeatedly, so he actually has 99 different cheering stickers in his album.

m-186.translation: I have no obligation to inform you; that's my privacy.

errors.note: “my privacy”搭配生硬，英语中通常说“that's private”或“that's a matter of my privacy”，此处不够自然。

m-183.translation: I can't take it anymore. This awkwardness is so intense I could dig out a three-bedroom apartment with my toes.

m-185.translation: I'm begging you, help me turn it down.

m-189.translation: I was so embarrassed just now!

m-188.translation: I'm crying, everyone. I'm a victim too.

errors.note: “流泪了”是网络口语，表示被感动或触动，并非真的在哭；“I'm crying”字面意思是在哭，意思有偏差。
“家人们”是网络称呼语，相当于“guys/friends”；“everyone”略显生硬，不够口语化。

m-192.translation: Teacher Jiu'er, when crying, this movement should also be added, right?

m-191.translation: My best friend beat me to saying everything I had planned to say for my confession.

m-197.translation: A friend borrowed money from me and said he'd pay it back in three days. It's been a month now and there's still no word.

m-194.translation: Heard a friend tell an incredibly awkward joke.

m-198.translation: Remember to tell Auntie that the earthquake made the room messy. That's how I got away with it last time.

m-199.translation: Why do they say Li Zongheng has never been on the Spring Festival Gala?

m-195.translation: Especially that sketch, it showcased the Northeasterners' sense of humor to the fullest. I saw the bullet comments all flooding with 'This is better than the Spring Festival Gala'.

errors.note: “Northeasterners”作为泛指略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是“Northeast people”或“people from the Northeast”。
“bullet comments”是弹幕的直译，英文观众不熟悉；常用说法是“danmu”或“on-screen comments”。
“all flooding with”稍显冗余、不够口语，可简化为“were all saying”。
“认”在此语境指辨认/认出（如让孩子认人），译为 recognize 偏“承认/认可”，意思有偏差，应为 identify/recognize who it is 之类。
直译生硬，不像口语字幕，英语中更自然说法如“Have Auntie take a look”或“Show Auntie”。

m-196.translation: I was trying to lose weight but got so hungry that I couldn't hold back and binge ate. After eating, I regretted it and tried to make myself throw up, but ended up scratching my throat.

errors.span: I was trying to lose weight but got so hungry that I couldn't hold back and binge ate
errors.note: 原文“减肥太饿没忍住暴饮暴食”是紧凑的因果链，译文用“but”把“减肥”和“太饿”处理成转折关系，逻辑连接略有偏差，但整体意思仍可理解。
“binge ate”作为动词短语不自然，英语通常说“binge”或“went on a binge”，此处措辞生硬。

errors.span: tried to make myself throw up
errors.note: 原文“去催吐”是已发生的动作，译文“tried to”弱化为尝试，且与后文“结果把嗓子划伤了”的实际结果在语气上略有不协调。

m-202.translation: I can already picture you waking up tomorrow with your hair all messy. With that hairstyle, you wouldn't be able to leave the house without spending at least an hour fixing it.

m-201.translation: Losing this game is all your fault.

m-205.translation: A friend said I look like a cricket.

m-203.translation: You're already crying from anxiety, and you're going to gain weight again.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张口语，意为“急得要哭/快急哭了”，译成“already crying from anxiety”变成真的在哭，语气和程度偏差明显。

errors.span: and you're going to gain weight again
errors.note: “又要长胖了”是调侃式口语，译文偏书面、生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-206.translation: Bro, your life is way too exciting.

m-207.translation: My child is about to take the high school entrance exam, and their science scores have always been unstable, especially in physics. Are there any efficient review methods?

errors.note: “理科”指数学、物理、化学、生物等理科科目，译成“science”范围偏窄，通常指科学/自然科学，未准确对应“理科成绩”。
“复习方法”在口语化字幕中译成“review methods”略显生硬，用“study methods”或“ways to review”更自然。

m-204.translation: If you lose the PK, add a purple monster, haha, that thing is way stronger than the gacha one, way stronger.

errors.note: “加紫色怪”在游戏语境中应指“加/刷紫色怪（关卡或怪物）”，译成“add a purple monster”像是让观众去添加一只紫色怪物，意思偏差明显。
“嘎嘎”是口语化的笑声/语气词，译成“haha”尚可，但语气偏弱，不够贴近原字幕的随意口语感。

errors.span: that thing is way stronger than the gacha one, way stronger
errors.note: 原文“那个比抽的，抽的，强太多了”中“抽的”指抽卡/抽取类玩法或对象，译文“the gacha one”将其具体化为“抽卡的那个”，且重复“way stronger”改变了原句的停顿和强调方式，意思有偏差。

m-211.translation: I'm begging you, okay? Don't look at me like that, I'm getting shy!

m-208.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier. I suggest just hiring a driver directly.

errors.span: I wish you'd told me earlier
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的惊讶/抱怨，译文用较书面、正式的虚拟语气，语气偏文雅，不够像字幕口语。

errors.span: I suggest just hiring a driver directly
errors.note: “建议直接雇个司机”是随口提议，译文“I suggest...directly”偏正式生硬，且“directly”略显冗余，不够口语自然。

m-210.translation: I've been wanting to learn how to cook recently, but I have absolutely zero foundation and don't know which dishes would be best to start learning from?

errors.note: “零基础”直译成 zero foundation 生硬，口语字幕更自然说法是 no experience / starting from scratch。

errors.span: which dishes would be best to start learning from?
errors.note: start learning from which dishes 搭配不自然，且句末用问号但整句为陈述语气，宜改为 ...which dishes would be best to start with.

m-213.translation: My boyfriend and I always argue over small things, like who should wash the dishes. How can we improve this situation?

m-209.translation: I'm dying laughing, your answer is way too outrageous.

errors.note: “I'm dying laughing”略显直译，作为字幕口语不如“I can't stop laughing”或“LMAO”自然，但意思可理解。
“离谱”在此语境指答案荒谬、荒唐，“outrageous”偏“令人震惊/过分”，语义略有偏差，用“ridiculous/absurd”更贴切。

m-212.translation: Swear you won't laugh out loud after watching this joke.

errors.span: Swear you won't laugh out loud after watching this joke.
errors.note: 原文“发誓看完这个段子不笑出声”是说话人自指（我发誓），译文变成祈使句让观众发誓，主语和语气都错了。

errors.span: Swear you won't laugh out loud after watching this joke.
errors.note: 作为字幕口语不够自然，英语观众更常说“I swear this joke won't make you laugh”之类，直译结构生硬。

errors.span: tonight is my seventh day after death
errors.note: “头七”是中文丧葬习俗的固定说法，指死后第七天亡魂回家，译文按字面直译成“死后第七天”，丢失了“亡魂回魂”这一关键文化含义，观众无法理解这句话的幽默/语境。

errors.span: tonight is my seventh day after death
errors.note: 作为字幕口语过于生硬冗长，不符合台词的自然语气。

errors.note: “不讲不讲”是俏皮地拒绝透露，译成“No, no”变成单纯否定，丢失了“我不说”的意思。

m-230.translation: I want to hear that I need to check my teammate's cards.

errors.note: 原文“想听”是“想听牌/想听（你）说”的语境，译文误加“hear that”把“想听”变成“想听到……”，且“that I need to”把说话人变成自己需要验牌，意思完全走偏。
原文“我要验队友的牌”是说话人打算验队友的牌，译文“I need to check my teammate's cards”虽大意接近，但“need to”弱化了“要（打算/要求）”的主动语气，且与前面“hear that”连读后语义混乱。

m-226.translation: Now that it's on, what am I supposed to watch for the Spring Festival Gala?

errors.note: “现在演了”指春晚正在播出/开始了，译文“Now that it's on”语义含糊，未准确传达“正在上演”的意思。

errors.span: what am I supposed to watch for the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 原文意思是“春晚都演了，我还看什么（春晚）”，即没得看了；译文却变成“为了春晚我该看什么”，意思完全相反。

m-229.translation: During the New Year, my son kept saying, "I want to check the cards," and "Wipe my shoes for me." There's no problem with the cards. I've practically been brainwashed by him.

errors.span: I want to check the cards
errors.note: 原文“是我要验牌”是儿子转述/模仿说话人自己的话（“说是我要验牌”），译文却译成儿子说“I want to check the cards”，把说话人变成了儿子，意思偏差。

m-231.translation: This world is too abstract; I choose to lie flat.

errors.note: “躺平”是网络流行语，直译为“lie flat”生硬，字幕口语中宜用更自然的表达（如“opt out”“check out”），但意思仍可理解。

errors.note: “耳听为虚”意为听到的不可靠，译文却译成“Hearing is believing”（听到就相信），意思完全相反。

m-239.translation: Was I wrong to joke, 'You can't even handle this little setback'?

m-237.translation: Six hundred sixty-six, kids these days really know their internet memes.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是网络用语“666”（表示厉害、牛），直译成数字会丢失原意，观众无法理解这是在夸赞。

errors.note: 原文“要检查下试卷”是说话人（老师/监考）的打算或要求，译成被动“needs to be checked”弱化了原意，但大意尚可。

m-242.translation: Reach 100 and use it as your profile picture for a week.

errors.span: Reach 100 and use it as your profile picture for a week.
errors.note: 原文“破100当一个星期头像”意为“（粉丝数/点赞数等）突破100后，把（某图）当一周头像”，译文“Reach 100 and use it as your profile picture for a week”把“it”指代不清，且“Reach 100”缺少宾语，未体现“破100”所指对象，意思有明显偏差。

errors.note: 间接引语语序生硬，'saying why...' 读起来不通顺，宜改为 'saying that lately so many people love shouting'。

errors.span: I want to verify the cards
errors.note: '我要验牌' 是网络流行语/口语喊话，直译成 'verify the cards' 偏书面生硬，作为字幕口语不够自然。

m-251.translation: When working out, I always can't help but follow the rhythm.

errors.span: fully loaded with a modern tech vibe

m-394.translation: My language skills: Wow, six hundred and sixty-six, hard to handle, outrageous, this move is too wild, simply absurd.

errors.note: “六百六十六”是中文网络俚语，意为“厉害/牛”，直译成数字会丢失原意并误导观众。
“难绷”是网络俚语，意为“忍不住笑/绷不住”，译成“hard to handle”意思偏差明显。
“逆天”在此为夸张俚语，意为“离谱/惊人”，译作“outrageous”尚可但略失口语夸张语气。

errors.span: this move is too wild, simply absurd
errors.note: “这操作太骚了简直离谱”是口语化网络表达，译文偏书面、生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-398.translation: Absolutely, I've been eating it for three days straight.

errors.note: “包的”是网络口语，意为“当然/肯定”，但“Absolutely”在此语境下更像是对对方话语的强烈赞同，而非对“包在我身上/没问题”这一承诺的回应，语气和语义有偏差。

m-402.translation: If it's for the elderly, remember to set up frequently used apps on the home screen and teach them to use voice control.

m-400.translation: When someone randomly criticizes me, I just really love using it, so what?

errors.note: “被人莫名其妙说了”指被人无端指责/说闲话，译文改成“criticizes me”（批评我），把“被说”误译为主动批评，且“randomly”偏“随机”，未体现“莫名其妙/无端”的语气。

errors.span: I just really love using it
errors.note: 原文“我就是很爱用啊”是回应他人对自己使用某物的指责，译文“I just really love using it”虽大意接近，但“just”位置使语气变成“我只是真的很爱用它”，与原文“我就是很爱用”的强调反驳语气有偏差，且“it”指代不明。
“怎么了？”在此语境是反问“那又怎样/有问题吗”，译作“so what?”语气偏冲、略带挑衅，与原文口语反问的自然语气不完全一致。

m-406.translation: The boss just sent out a bizarre notice.

m-403.translation: This meme is way too abstract, I totally don't get it.

m-405.translation: A friend recommended a super hilarious variety show.

m-401.translation: If you want to stay up late binge-watching shows, then binge-watch. If you want to eat hot pot, then eat hot pot. No need to report in, no need to check up on anyone. Spending your entire salary on yourself—how could that not make you happy?

errors.span: no need to check up on anyone
errors.note: “查岗”指查伴侣的岗/行踪，译文“check up on anyone”泛化为查任何人，偏离原意。

errors.span: Spending your entire salary on yourself—how could that not make you happy?
errors.note: 原文“工资全花给自己不快乐吗？”是反问式口语，译文用破折号加“how could that not”略显书面生硬，不够字幕口语化。

m-407.translation: I just joined a new company and noticed that my colleagues all eat lunch together, but I'm rather introverted. How can I naturally fit in with them?

m-409.translation: So what? They're all little animals, what's the difference?

m-404.translation: Hey guys in front of the screen, do you think I sneaked a bite of the dragon fruit?

errors.span: Hey guys in front of the screen
errors.note: 直译“屏幕前的老铁们”，英文口语中不自然，通常说“Hey guys watching”或“Hey everyone”。
“偷吃”指背着人吃，译为“sneaked a bite”略有偏差，更贴切的是“ate ... on the sly”或“secretly ate”，但意思基本可理解。

m-408.translation: I'm begging you, let me borrow it for a day.

m-410.translation: You're really hungry, huh? Was it just cooked?

m-413.translation: No one did worse than me on this exam, right?

m-411.translation: Hurry up and save him, or he'll be your husband.

errors.note: “九九”是角色名/称呼，不是“救他”，译文把对象完全译错，观众会得到错误信息。
原文“不然就是你老公”意为“否则（九九）就是你老公”，译文改成“他会成为你老公”，主语和关系指向错误。

m-414.translation: After exercising, my clothes are all soaked with sweat.

m-416.translation: You sold all my game equipment, didn't you?

m-417.translation: I've decided to start losing weight tomorrow.

m-418.translation: I'm begging you, hahaha, don't check my homework!

m-412.translation: Actually, it's not that low either. In places like Muling and Niu Zihan where there are lots of trolls, many people spam "you're already crying from anxiety" — it's almost become standard.

errors.note: “串子”指故意挑事、反串引战的人，译成 trolls 大致可接受，但此处更接近“反串/钓鱼”的语境，语义有偏差。
“你已急哭”是网络梗，指对方急到哭，译成 crying from anxiety 略显解释化，但意思基本传达。
“都快成标配了”口语感较强，译文偏书面，字幕口语度稍弱。

m-415.translation: Six hundred sixty-six, big shot, take me with you!

errors.note: “六百六十六”是网络用语“666”（表示厉害、牛），直译成数字会让英文观众误解为字面数字，丢失原意。

errors.span: big shot, take me with you!
errors.note: “大佬带带我”是口语化玩梗表达，直译“big shot, take me with you”生硬且语气不对，不像字幕口语。

m-419.translation: Child's father: What should I do? I want to laugh too.

errors.note: “怎么办”在此处是口语化的无奈/好笑感叹，译成“What should I do?”显得生硬、像在求助，不够自然。

m-420.translation: He's looking at you all helplessly from the sky, exactly the same.

errors.note: “失禁”意为失去大小便控制（incontinence），并非“无助地”（helplessly），译文完全改变了原意。
原文“失禁”这一关键信息被误译为 helplessly，属于误译/漏译。

m-423.translation: What exactly does "cabbage smiling at me" mean?

m-421.translation: No way, can you share some of your luck with me?

errors.note: “不处”是网络口语，意为“不处对象/不谈恋爱”，译成“No way”改变了意思，变成表示惊讶或拒绝。

m-424.translation: The Qing Dynasty has been gone for so long, yet this kind of workplace oppression still exists.

m-426.translation: I'm the one who reads but doesn't reply.

m-425.translation: I'm already picturing you drinking water with it—you'll definitely be the coolest one in the office!

m-422.translation: I thought this meme has always been a classic; I'm used to using it along with everyday conversations.

errors.note: 原文“一直都是”指从过去到现在持续的状态，应译为“has always been”所对应的现在完成时含义，但“I thought”后接“has always been”时态搭配不当，且未能准确表达“一直”的持续含义，建议用“had always been”或“was always”。

errors.span: I'm used to using it along with everyday conversations
errors.note: “along with everyday conversations”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法为“in everyday conversations”或“with everyday conversation”。

m-430.translation: The blind date suddenly stopped talking.

m-427.translation: I highly recommend you go listen to it.

m-431.translation: The owner's wife of this shop secretly told me the exclusive recipe.

errors.span: The owner's wife of this shop
errors.note: 生硬且歧义：'owner's wife of this shop' 不如 'the shop owner's wife' 自然，且 'owner's wife' 可能被理解为店主本人是女性。
'exclusive recipe' 偏书面/营销腔，字幕口语中更自然的是 'secret recipe'。

m-428.translation: The sunny boy Huang Buliqiu teaches everyone to use the new meme "Who cares about you."

errors.note: “黄不溜秋”是描述性绰号（意为“黄得发暗/土黄”），音译成 Huang Buliqiu 丢失了含义，观众无法理解这个昵称。
“谁理你”更接近“who cares about you / who'd bother with you”的口语梗，译文基本达意，但作为梗的固定说法略显直译，可考虑加引号内更口语化的表达。

m-433.translation: Just saw a new legendary meme.

m-434.translation: Why are so many people online saying 'sure sure' or 'okay okay' these days?

errors.note: 原文只提到“可以可以”一种说法，译文增译了“okay okay”，添加了原文没有的内容。

m-432.translation: I just saw that several new stores have opened nearby—hot pot, barbecue, and crawfish are all available. My indecision is kicking in.

errors.note: “stores”偏指零售商店，这里指餐饮店，用“restaurants/eateries”更自然。
“indecision is kicking in”略显生硬，口语字幕中“I can't decide”更自然。

m-439.translation: When you run into your boss in the elevator, you don't know whether you should say hello.

errors.note: “不处”这一口语表达（意为“不行/不合适”）被译为“No”，丢失了其具体含义，且与“这么做不地道”的语义关系被压缩。
“不地道”指做法不合规矩、不地道，译为“not right”过于笼统，未体现“不地道/不合规矩”的含义。

m-435.translation: This move is so classic. My ex was just as perfunctory with me, even replying to important questions with only emojis.

errors.note: “This move is so classic”偏书面/生硬，口语字幕里说“That's such a classic move”或“So typical”更自然。
“perfunctory”较正式书面，与口语字幕语气不符，用“half-hearted”“going through the motions”更贴切。

m-437.translation: Why are you scrolling through handsome guy videos again?

m-440.translation: I want to start a new segment but I don't know what to broadcast.

errors.note: “broadcast”指电台/电视播出，用于网络栏目内容显得生硬，口语字幕用“what to do”“what to feature”等更自然。

m-438.translation: The coach said to adjust your own condition before the match.

errors.note: 原文“自己”指教练自己（主语），译文用“your own”变成对听者说的，人称指代错误，改变了意思。
“condition”在此语境下偏生硬，指“状态”更自然的说法是“form”或“shape”。

m-441.translation: The two cities are a 2-hour direct high-speed rail ride apart. Remember to book a homestay inside the ancient town in advance, and bring sunscreen and moisturizing products.

m-446.translation: My roommate plays games late at night, and the keyboard noise keeps me awake.

m-443.translation: How should I reply to this?

m-444.translation: Say one more word and I'm going to explode.

m-442.translation: 666, there's even a second level. This brings back memories.

errors.note: 中文网络用语“666”意为“厉害/牛”，直译成英文数字“666”在英语观众看来无意义，应意译为“Awesome”之类。
“爷青回”是网络流行语，意为“我的青春回来了”，译文“This brings back memories”意思接近但语气偏平淡，未体现原词的俏皮口语感。

m-447.translation: You say he loves cleanliness, but he dries his socks and wears them again. You say he doesn't love cleanliness, but he at least knows to dry them before wearing them again.

errors.note: “loves cleanliness”较书面，字幕口语中更自然说法是“likes to keep clean”之类，但不影响理解。

errors.span: You say he doesn't love cleanliness
errors.note: 同上，重复使用“love cleanliness”略显生硬、不够口语化。

m-445.translation: You're already crying from anxiety. If you don't buy now, I'm really going to cry.

errors.note: “你已急哭”是夸张/调侃的说法，指对方急得不行，并非真的在哭；译成“crying from anxiety”把比喻坐实，意思有明显偏差。
原文“再不买”是“再不下单/不买的话”，译文加了“now”，语义略有增补，但影响不大。

m-449.translation: The person I have a secret crush on is with someone else now.

m-448.translation: It's best to choose one that includes door-to-door installation service, so the elderly don't have to deal with it themselves.

errors.note: “带上门安装服务”指包含上门安装的服务，而“door-to-door”意为送货上门，误译了安装服务的性质。

errors.span: so the elderly don't have to deal with it themselves
errors.note: “折腾”口语化，译文略显生硬，可更自然如“so the elderly don't have to go through the hassle themselves”。

m-450.translation: Take it seriously and note it down in the little notebook.

errors.span: note it down in the little notebook
errors.note: “little notebook”过于直译，口语字幕中“记小本本上”更自然的说法是“put it in my little book”或“write it down”，但意思仍可理解。

m-452.translation: I really don't have time to mess around with you. It's totally normal for a girl to spend half an hour on makeup, okay?

m-451.translation: "What about it, who cares about you" — only when you put it together does it become a real new meme.

errors.note: “谁理你”是“谁在乎/搭理你”的口语说法，译成“who cares about you”变成“谁关心你”，意思有偏差。

errors.span: only when you put it together does it become a real new meme
errors.note: 过于书面、冗长，不像字幕口语，可更简洁自然。

m-453.translation: At the same time, cultivate your own hobbies and interests, and do not rely on the other person excessively.

m-455.translation: Recently I've noticed that my favorite music has been overused in short videos again.

m-457.translation: The boss said we have to work overtime for a month straight.

m-456.translation: Working through the night tonight, no room for discussion.

m-454.translation: There are only 3 people watching the livestream.

m-458.translation: Bro, you're not gonna let me copy off you on tomorrow's final exam?

m-459.translation: Time can be divided, for example, 10 minutes in the morning and 10 minutes in the evening.

m-462.translation: I can't even, this meme is way too abstract, I'm laughing so hard my stomach hurts.

m-461.translation: How would you describe a streamer who openly asks a big spender for gifts?

m-460.translation: Back in the day, I was full of spirit and vigor, and my skills were so impressive that I commanded respect from all sides.

errors.span: my skills were so impressive that I commanded respect from all sides
errors.note: “一手操作”指亲自操作/一手操办，译文泛化为“skills”，且“八面威风”被译成“commanded respect from all sides”，丢失了“威风凛凛、气势逼人”的意味，意思有明显偏差。
“意气风发”译得偏书面、生硬，作为字幕口语不够自然。

m-465.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier—I just finished styling my hair and now there's snowflake-like flakes all over the pillow.

errors.note: “snowflake-like flakes”生硬且重复，口语字幕中“snowflake-like”或“flakes”单独使用更自然。

m-463.translation: You think playing with abstraction is easy? You have to get up at five every morning to memorize memes.

errors.note: “玩抽象”是网络俚语，指玩梗/搞荒诞幽默，不是字面上的“playing with abstraction”，直译会让观众误解原意。
“背梗”指背网络段子/梗，译成“memorize memes”基本可接受，但“memes”偏指梗图，略窄；可考虑“memorize jokes/memes”更贴切。

m-466.translation: The blogger acts out the meme "I want to check the cards."

errors.note: “窝要”是“我要”的谐音/口音梗，译文直接写成“I want to”丢失了梗的谐音趣味，未体现原文的玩梗效果。

errors.span: The blogger acts out the meme
errors.note: “acts out the meme”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“does the meme”或“recreates the meme”。

m-467.translation: I can't take it anymore, this is way too embarrassing.

m-468.translation: We agreed to save money together, but you're shopping nonstop every day.

errors.note: “剁手”是网络俚语，指冲动网购，译文用“shopping nonstop”只表达了不停购物，未体现冲动消费的意味，但整体意思基本保留。

m-469.translation: Remember, you're there to bless the newlyweds, so dressing appropriately and elegantly is what matters most.

m-470.translation: This is six hundred sixty-six, the kind that won't sink.

errors.note: “六百六十六”在此语境中很可能是网络/口语用语（如“666”表示厉害），直译为数字会丢失原意，可能误导观众。
“沉不下去的那种”译得偏书面、生硬，字幕口语中不够自然。

m-473.translation: Especially those extreme comeback plays, they make my hands itch and I want to jump into a match myself.

m-472.translation: The controls in this game are absolutely amazing.

errors.note: “太秀了”是口语化网络用语，带有调侃、赞叹的语气，译成“absolutely amazing”偏正式、平淡，口语感和语气强度略有流失。

m-475.translation: I've been thinking about trying baking at home recently, but I have no experience at all. Are there any simple recipes suitable for beginners that you'd recommend?

m-471.translation: My roommate secretly watches funny videos under the covers in the middle of the night, holding back laughter so as not to make a sound.

errors.span: holding back laughter so as not to make a sound
errors.note: 冗长且书面化，字幕口语中更自然简洁的说法是“stifling his laughter”或“holding back his laughter”。

errors.span: in the middle of the night
errors.note: “半夜”译为“in the middle of the night”偏啰嗦，字幕中“late at night”更简洁自然。

m-476.translation: 666 And there's a second level too—this homage is an absolutely perfect recreation!

m-477.translation: You can prepare an error notebook to record typical problems and clever solution methods.

m-479.translation: A netizen suddenly sent a voice call.

errors.note: “发语音通话”指发起/拨打语音通话，译文“sent a voice call”暗示发送了通话记录或消息，意思有偏差，应为“started/made a voice call”。

m-484.translation: My sister said she successfully dodged her blind date's barrage of questions by playing dumb.

m-478.translation: I can't believe you didn't say that earlier—I thought it was my own original style!

m-481.translation: Can you just talk properly and stop beating around the bush?

m-480.translation: My mom actually sent me a red envelope on her own initiative.

errors.note: “on her own initiative”偏书面正式，字幕口语中更自然的是“on her own”或“by herself”，语气不够口语化。

m-483.translation: You're literally their sugar daddy, haha, the whole class is counting on you to support them.

errors.note: “活爹”是调侃某人像爹一样被全班依赖供养，而“sugar daddy”特指以金钱换取陪伴的包养关系，含义明显偏差且带有不当的性暗示。

m-485.translation: I see my best friend is showing off her boyfriend on Moments again.

m-486.translation: This year's Liaoning Spring Festival Gala has indeed made great progress; both the program arrangement and stage design have been aligned with the CCTV Spring Festival Gala.

m-487.translation: I'm done for, huh? Now I've been exposed.

errors.note: “huh?” 读起来像在寻求确认，而原文“我不行了吧”是说话人对自己撑不住了的自我怀疑式判断，语气略有偏差。

m-488.translation: Additionally, you can set up an online study room with friends to supervise each other, or play white noise in the background to help with concentration.

m-491.translation: What exactly is the scope of tomorrow's exam?

m-490.translation: You're already crying from anxiety—top student, hurry up and let me copy your homework.

errors.note: “急哭”是夸张口语，意为“急得不行/快急死了”，并非真的在哭；译成“crying from anxiety”会让观众以为人物真的在流泪，意思明显偏差。

errors.span: top student, hurry up and let me copy your homework
errors.note: “学霸快借我抄抄”是同学间随意的口语调侃，译文偏直译、语气生硬，缺少口语化的自然感。

m-489.translation: After moving, I found that the original room was even cleaner than when I lived there.

errors.note: “原来的房间”指搬家前住过的那个房间，译成“the original room”会被理解为“原本的那个房间/原始房间”，意思偏差明显，应译为“my old room”或“the room I used to live in”。
原文“住的时候”指自己住在那里的时期，译文“when I lived there”基本达意，但“there”指代略含糊，可更明确为“when I was living there”。

m-495.translation: Are there any simple and easy-to-learn beginner recipes you would recommend?

m-496.translation: Even begging has to wait in line—there are 999+ more behind.

m-492.translation: Recently, a lot of people online have been saying "666, even the salt isn't salty anymore" — what's going on with that?

errors.span: 666, even the salt isn't salty anymore
errors.note: “六百六十六盐都不盐了”是网络流行语/谐音梗，直译成“666, even the salt isn't salty anymore”会让英文观众完全摸不着头脑，属于误译/未传达原意。
中文“六百六十六”在字幕中通常写作数字，但此处作为网络用语直接保留数字尚可；不过与后文直译搭配显得生硬。

m-494.translation: Take it seriously and finish all his snacks tonight.

errors.note: “炫光”是网络口语，带夸张、狼吞虎咽的意味，“finish all his snacks”偏中性书面，语气不够口语化。

m-493.translation: My mood: Like: I can't take it anymore. Nervous: I can't take it anymore. Happy: I can't take it anymore. Help, I'm so panicked.

errors.note: “救命我好慌”是网络口语，意为“救命，我好慌/好紧张”，译成“so panicked”语气过重且偏正式，与原文轻松自嘲的语气不符。
重复三次的“我不行了”是口语化夸张表达，译文偏书面、生硬，缺少字幕口语感。

m-498.translation: The advisor notified us that there's a sudden group meeting tonight.

m-497.translation: Couldn't hold back my laughter in class, and when the teacher called on me to answer, I burped.

m-499.translation: I can't take it anymore, really can't.

m-503.translation: My friend said they'd treat me to a meal, but every time they make excuses to get out of it.

m-500.translation: Generally, after 2-3 weeks, once everyone gets familiar with you, they will naturally accept you. Just stay friendly and participate moderately in the early stage.

m-501.translation: The content is too real and abstract.

errors.note: “过于真实又抽象”是网络口语，指内容既真实得扎心又荒诞离奇；直译为“too real and abstract”生硬，未传达“又……又……”的口语语气，也不像字幕口语。

m-502.translation: This level is way too high!

errors.span: This level is way too high!
errors.note: “水平”指技能/水准，不是“level（层级/高度）”；译文把“水平高”误解为“level too high”，意思发生偏差。

m-512.translation: 3-4 times a week, 40 minutes each time.

errors.span: let me lie down for a bit first

errors.note: “超话”是微博的粉丝社区功能，通常译作 “super topic” 虽可理解，但更常见的说法是 “Weibo super topic” 或 “fan community”；不过 “super topic” 作为直译也说得通，所以只是轻微问题。
“刷数据”指人为刷高互动数据；“doing data boosts” 略显生硬、不够口语化，更自然的说法是 “boosting the numbers” 或 “inflating the stats”。

m-526.translation: Or is it Daniel who sings?

m-524.translation: I remember you were saying just last week that you're socially anxious—this contrast is way too big!

errors.span: this contrast is way too big
errors.note: “contrast is way too big”偏直译、生硬，口语字幕里更自然说法是“that's a huge difference”或“what a contrast”。
“社恐”是口语化网络用语，译成临床味较重的“socially anxious”语气略正式，用“socially awkward/shy”更贴近原口语色彩。

m-527.translation: My boyfriend and I always argue over small things, like who washes the dishes or being late for dates. How can we improve the way we get along?

m-525.translation: Why do you watch such abstract stuff every day? Watch something normal—your brain is going to short-circuit. Hurry up and switch to some healthy content.

errors.note: “抽象”是中文网络口语，指内容怪异、让人看不懂，译成“abstract stuff”会让英语观众误以为是“抽象艺术/抽象概念”，意思明显偏差。

errors.span: your brain is going to short-circuit
errors.note: “脑子瓦特了”是方言口语，意为“脑子坏掉/犯傻”，译成“short-circuit”偏字面，语气和含义略有偏差。

m-530.translation: Avoid all-black suits as they can look too serious, and don't wear jeans.

m-529.translation: Born with an abstract sacred body—seeing this, my brain just crashed instantly.

errors.span: Born with an abstract sacred body
errors.note: “抽象圣体”是网络梗，指人行为抽象/离谱，并非“神圣的身体”，直译成 sacred body 严重误解原意。

“大脑宕机”译成 brain crashed 偏直译，英语口语更常说 my brain just froze/shut down，instantly 也略显冗余。

errors.span: I'll wait until I return to the country

“水军”指有组织的网络刷评/带节奏群体，“paid commenters”仅指付费评论者，未体现操纵舆论的含义，可考虑“paid trolls/water army”。

m-533.translation: But doesn't anyone think the word 'very annoying' is also very annoying? (I'm out of here, I'm really illiterate)

errors.note: 原文中“很烦”是被讨论的词本身，译文用“very annoying”来翻译它，但随后又说这个词“very annoying”，导致自指关系混乱；应保留被引用的词形，如“very annoying”作为被谈论的词，但整体逻辑需一致。
“丈育”是网络用语（“文盲”的谐音/戏称），译成“illiterate”过于正式直白，口语字幕中不够自然，但意思可理解。

m-532.translation: The "One Hundred Thousand Memes" series showcases the "read but reply randomly" meme, which reflects a healthy state of mind.

errors.note: “十万个梗库”指梗的合集/库，译成“One Hundred Thousand Memes”变成十万个梗的数量，意思偏差。

errors.span: which reflects a healthy state of mind
errors.note: 原文“精神状态良好”是网络反讽用语，指梗所展示的精神状态，译文增译并直译为“reflects a healthy state of mind”，改变了反讽语气和指向。

errors.span: showcases the "read but reply randomly" meme
errors.note: 字幕口语中“showcases”偏书面生硬，且单数“meme”与系列展示多个梗不符。

m-528.translation: Rank, lewd, lust, foul, and oil—all five vices in one.

errors.note: “腥”指鱼腥味/腥臭，不是“rank”（等级/地位），完全误译。
“骚”指臊味（动物膻腥气味），被误译为淫秽/色欲，属误译。
“膻”指羊膻味，译成泛泛的“foul”丢失了具体气味含义，且与“腥”混淆。
“油”在此指油腻/油味，直译为“oil”生硬，未体现“五毒”中气味/味道的语境。
原文“五毒俱全”是成语，指各种坏习气/毒害样样都有；译文将其具体化为五种“vice”，且把气味词当作恶习，语义偏差明显。

m-536.translation: I was already feeling uncomfortable, and laughing made my stomach hurt even more.

errors.note: “难受”在此语境指身体不适/难受（如肚子不舒服），译成“feeling uncomfortable”偏向心理上的不自在，意思有偏差。
原文“肚子更痛了”是“笑”导致肚子（因笑而）更痛，译文“laughing made my stomach hurt even more”基本达意，但“stomach hurt”略偏“胃痛”，可更贴近“肚子（笑）痛”。

m-538.translation: So what? Who cares about you? Watch it if you want, or don't bother.

“不看拉倒”的“拉倒”带不耐烦、无所谓语气，don't bother 偏“不必费心”，语气略弱，但基本可接受。

m-539.translation: So what if I watch it? I'll even use your membership to watch it. Love you, old self, see you every day.

errors.note: “爱你老己”是网络口语/谐音梗（“老己”指自己，带调侃语气），译成“old self”字面化且误解，意思明显偏差。

errors.span: Love you, old self, see you every day.
errors.note: 整句生硬直译，不像口语字幕，语气与原句调侃口吻不符。

errors.span: Your values are going to get completely overturned.

m-540.translation: At first I thought it was the Virgin Mary, but it turned out to be Satan telling a story.

errors.note: “圣母”在此是口语化比喻，指“圣母心/圣母婊”式的人物，并非特指圣母玛利亚，译成 the Virgin Mary 改变了原意。

“年轻貌美”直译为形容词并列，缺少主语衔接，作为祝福语读起来略不自然。

errors.note: and 连接后主语混乱，读起来像“我发截图并且我看结果”，句子不通顺。

m-550.translation: Not funny, what's so funny about that?

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不处对象/不交往”，被误译为“Not funny”，意思完全偏离。

errors.span: mainly just going with the flow

errors.note: “小姐姐”是中文网络用语，译为“Hey girl”略显生硬且带英语俚语色彩，不够贴合原口语语气。

errors.note: 原文是“百万粉丝”（a million fans），译文“millions of fans”夸大为数百万，数量信息有偏差。

errors.note: “支棱起来了”是口语化表达，指振作、有底气、不再被动；译为“geared up”偏“做好准备”，语气和意味略有偏差。

errors.span: I want to inspect the cards!

m-582.translation: Mom still knows you well—you pause and rewatch whenever you scroll to a handsome guy.

m-579.translation: I feel like a lot of people in the comments section really want to show off their talent for being abstract.

m-587.translation: All three models offer excellent display quality, and the 120Hz high refresh rate makes video playback very smooth.

errors.note: “硬控”是网络口语，指被牢牢吸引、无法移开注意力，译成“被完全控制”改变了意思，暗示鸽子实际控制了他。

errors.span: this sleeping posture is way too artistic
errors.note: “sleeping posture”偏书面/生硬，字幕口语中更自然的是“sleeping position”或“way of sleeping”。

m-602.translation: At least it didn't throw a pile of crap in your face right from the first video.

errors.note: “斤”是中文计量单位，直接音译为 jin 会让英语观众无法理解具体重量，宜换算或加注（如 1.5 kg / 3 jin）。

m-600.translation: Got in touch with the ex again. Because of the baby? Can't hold it in. Likes eating shit.

errors.span: Can't hold it in. Likes eating shit.
errors.note: 原文“兜不住屎 喜欢吃屎”是对宝宝/前任的粗俗调侃（指控制不住排便、吃屎），译文“Can't hold it in”丢失了“屎”这一宾语，且“Likes eating shit”主语不明，整体意思严重偏离，观众无法理解原意。
漏译“屎”，原文明确说“兜不住屎”，译文只说“憋不住”，信息缺失。
缺少主语，作为字幕口语略显突兀，与前句衔接不自然。

m-603.translation: You save money on eyeliner and still get that Western makeup look. I suggest you just take a photo and post it on Moments saying it's the latest trendy makeup style—it'll definitely go viral.

errors.note: “朋友圈”的官方英文名是 WeChat Moments，单用 Moments 对不熟悉微信的观众不够清楚。
“欧美妆”指欧美风格的妆容，译成 Western makeup look 基本达意，但略偏字面，可更自然地说 Euro-American style makeup。

m-605.translation: The team leader said that when he's not around, we should solve problems on our own.

m-606.translation: Slacking off at work, I scrolled past an awkward Moments post from a colleague.

errors.note: “刷到”指刷到并看到这条内容，而“scrolled past”暗示直接滑过去了，可能没看，语义略有偏差。

m-609.translation: I haven't bought an oven yet. Is there a simple recipe that doesn't require an oven?

m-610.translation: You actually just realized the key point I was making.

m-607.translation: I urgently need a set of Shiba Inu emojis that can express the state of office workers.

errors.note: “急需”译为“I urgently need”偏正式书面，字幕口语中更自然的是“I really need”之类，语气略显生硬。
“打工人状态”直译为“the state of office workers”较生硬，英文口语更常说“what it's like to be a worker”或“office worker mood”，措辞不够自然。

m-608.translation: Sorry, but I'm really so embarrassed I could curl my toes, I wish I could switch to another planet on the spot.

errors.note: “脚趾抠地”是中文网络用语，表示极度尴尬；直译成“curl my toes”在英语中并不传达尴尬之意，属于字面直译，意思略有偏差。

errors.span: I wish I could switch to another planet on the spot
errors.note: 整句偏书面、生硬，作为字幕口语不够自然，且逗号连接两个独立句造成逗号拼接。

m-612.translation: At the same time, your company's XX culture (employee development, technological innovation, etc.) is particularly attractive to me.

m-615.translation: Just got out of the shower and realized I forgot to grab a towel.

m-616.translation: An inexplicable punchline, and I actually laughed out loud.

errors.note: “笑点”指好笑之处/笑料，而“punchline”特指笑话的包袱或点睛之句，语义有偏差，容易让观众误解为某个具体的包袱句。

m-617.translation: Hurry up and get online to play games with me. You're the only one missing.

m-619.translation: Seeing your video on the subway and trying not to laugh is so hard.

m-618.translation: Begging the art team, when will they give this goddess an outfit that actually fits her character?

errors.note: 作为独立分句悬垂且不完整，英语中更自然的说法是“I'm begging the art team”或“Begging the art team: when...”。
“they”指代不明，且间接疑问句语序在字幕中略显生硬；更口语化的说法是“when will the art team give...”或“when are they going to give...”。

m-621.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier. I thought this was called being real and unpretentious.

errors.span: I wish you'd told me earlier
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的抱怨/惊讶，译文偏正式书面，语气不够自然，但意思基本保留。

m-625.translation: My mom is forcing me to go on a blind date.

m-620.translation: Can we get the key points for this exam?

errors.note: “搞到重点”指设法弄到考试重点/内部资料，含打探、获取之意，译成“get the key points”弱化为获取要点，丢失了“设法弄到（可能不正当）重点”的含义。

errors.span: Can we get the key points for this exam?
errors.note: 字幕口语中“搞到”更自然对应“get hold of / get our hands on”，现译偏书面、语气不够口语化。

m-623.translation: I won't say it, I won't say it, my wallet is going to be empty again.

errors.span: I won't say it, I won't say it
errors.note: “不讲不讲”是口语化的拒绝/回避说法（类似“别提了/不说了”），译成“I won't say it”变成字面“我不肯说”，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: my wallet is going to be empty again
errors.note: “钱包又要瘪了”是口语化表达，直译成“wallet is going to be empty”略显生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-622.translation: The best experience is to open it again on your birthday. If you open it now, there will be no surprise then.

errors.note: “再拆一遍”指生日当天再拆一次，译文“open it again”暗示已经拆过一次，与原文“现在拆了到时就没惊喜”的语境不符，容易误导。
“there will be no surprise then”略显生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“by then”或“when the time comes”。

m-626.translation: What should I do when video chatting with my long-distance boyfriend often has awkward silences and I can't find topics to talk about?

m-624.translation: What do you mean by "I won't say it, I won't say it"? Your awakening is way too sudden, isn't it?

errors.span: Your awakening is way too sudden, isn't it?
errors.note: “觉醒”直译为 awakening 在口语语境中生硬，英文更自然说法如 “You woke up way too suddenly” 或 “That was a sudden change of heart”。

m-627.translation: Is it like watching the Spring Festival Gala?

errors.span: Is it like watching the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 原文是口语化的反问/感叹（“相当春晚看啊？”），译文用完整疑问句“Is it like...”显得生硬、书面，缺少字幕口语的自然语气。

m-628.translation: So what? Isn't this just the standard package for dating?

errors.span: Working late until the early morning, my colleague said I was pretending to work hard.
errors.note: 悬垂修饰语：分词短语的逻辑主语应是“我”，但主句主语是“my colleague”，造成语法错误和语义混乱。
“装努力”指假装努力/做样子，译成“pretending to work hard”尚可，但“装”的口语贬义色彩略弱，可更贴近“putting on a show of working hard”。

m-632.translation: I only acknowledge Zhazha Hui and his grandpa when it comes to reading without replying properly.

errors.note: “已读乱回”是网络用语，指已读后胡乱回复，译文“reading without replying properly”把“乱回”误解为“不恰当回复/不回复”，意思有偏差。
“我只认准”口语中表示“我只认可/只服”，用“acknowledge”偏书面生硬，不像字幕口语。
“渣渣辉”是知名网络昵称，音译可接受，但缺少注释或更通行译法，观众可能无法识别指代。

m-631.translation: Even the keyboard isn't as keyboard as you. The keyboard would take one look at you and say, "What a key, what a key!"

errors.span: Even the keyboard isn't as keyboard as you.
errors.note: 把“键盘”当形容词用的双关在英语里很生硬，但基本还能传达原文的文字游戏。

errors.span: What a key, what a key!
errors.note: “好键啊好键”的感叹语气被译成“What a key”，略显别扭，不过保留了双关。

m-635.translation: The cafeteria ladies this year are way too abstract.

errors.note: “抽象”是中文网络俚语，意为怪异、离谱、难以理解，直译为“abstract”会让英文观众误解为字面意义上的抽象概念。
直译的俚语在英文字幕中显得生硬、不自然，不符合口语化字幕的语气。

m-637.translation: Can I pick a song first?

errors.note: “憋出内伤”是夸张说法，指强忍笑意憋得难受，并非真的血管破裂；“burst a blood vessel”在英语中多指暴怒或医学上的血管破裂，语义偏差明显。

errors.span: trying to hold back my laughter
errors.note: 表达偏书面、冗长，字幕口语中更自然简洁的说法是“holding back my laughter”或“keeping a straight face”。

errors.span: I'm going to hold you accountable
errors.note: “找你算账”是口语化的威胁/抱怨，译为“hold you accountable”偏正式、书面，语气不够自然，不太像字幕口语。

errors.note: “it can suddenly move people to tears”作为字幕口语略显生硬，用“suddenly tug at people's heartstrings”或“suddenly hit you emotionally”更自然。

errors.note: “大数据推送”直译生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法是“big data recommendations”或“algorithmic recommendations”。

errors.span: Absolutely, that's how precise big data push recommendations are.
errors.note: 整体句式偏书面、不够口语化，与原文随意的网络口语语气不太匹配。

errors.note: 整体偏书面、生硬，字幕口语中更自然说法如“Memes these days are too abstract—I can't even tell...”。

m-681.translation: My roommate is still on a call with their partner late at night, whispering cheesy pickup lines.

errors.note: “连麦”指语音通话，并未暗示低声耳语，whispering 属于增译。

m-678.translation: I can't even, I'm dying laughing, this scene is so full of flavor

m-682.translation: Can we cover 100 knowledge points in one video?

m-684.translation: I can't take it anymore, I'm so broke I'm about to eat dirt.

m-683.translation: Want to play games together this weekend?

m-685.translation: I can't keep going. I'm going to sleep first.

m-690.translation: The highest form of abstraction is not simple abstraction, but the sublimation of abstract art.

m-688.translation: But my figure is truly amazing, so it's no wonder you can't sleep.

errors.note: “神妙”意为奇妙、不可思议，带有神秘或玄妙意味，译成“truly amazing”（只是“很棒”）丢失了这层含义，语义有明显偏差。

errors.span: so it's no wonder you can't sleep
errors.note: 原文“这不怪你睡不着”意为“这不能怪你睡不着”，即“你睡不着情有可原”，译文用“no wonder”基本传达了因果，但“不怪”的“不能怪你”语气略有偏移。

m-692.translation: In tears—is this the legendary method of spiritual victory?

m-693.translation: What's the punchline of this meme?

m-696.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier—now I have to stay up late again tonight.

m-695.translation: I can't take it anymore, I said no matter how I count, there are four people.

errors.note: “我说”是说话人自言自语/感叹的语气词，译成“I said”会被理解为“我曾经说过”，意思偏差明显。
“我不行了”在此语境是“我服了/受不了这怪事”的感叹，译成“I can't take it anymore”语气过重，偏向无法忍受，不够口语自然。

m-699.translation: I'm crying, I didn't do it on purpose!

errors.note: “流泪”在此是撒娇/委屈的语气词，并非陈述“我正在哭”，直译成 I'm crying 改变了原意和语气。

errors.span: I'm crying, I didn't do it on purpose!
errors.note: 整体语气偏生硬书面，缺少原文“人家不是故意的嘛”那种撒娇、口语化的口吻。

m-697.translation: I can't take it anymore, let me take a breather.

m-694.translation: Were you involved in planning, producing, or writing for the Spring Festival Gala?

errors.span: Were you involved in planning, producing, or writing for the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 原文是带讽刺意味的推测句（“有你……的吧”），译文变成中性疑问句，语气和口语感偏弱。

errors.note: “stunned by me”略显生硬，英语字幕更自然的说法是“stunned by it”或“stunned”，但意思仍然清楚。

errors.span: There is no obligation to inform every night.

m-924.translation: Wait until I get back to China to handle it, then we'll see who's begging whom.

m-925.translation: I posted a ton of hilarious memes on my Moments.

errors.note: “沙雕段子”指搞笑/无厘头的文字段子或笑话，译成“memes”改变了内容类型，意思有明显偏差。
“朋友圈”是微信专有功能，通常译为“WeChat Moments”，单用“Moments”略欠明确。

m-919.translation: Eating while having a flashback—this move is like rubbing salt in the wound and then asking if it's salty enough. Absolutely savage.

errors.note: “绝了”是感叹“太离谱/太狠了”，译成“Absolutely savage”偏向“野蛮/凶残”，语义偏差，且丢失了原文调侃吐槽的语气。

errors.span: this move is like rubbing salt in the wound and then asking if it's salty enough
errors.note: 译文把“伤口上撒盐还问你咸淡合适不”直译得较长较书面，作为字幕口语略显生硬，但意思基本传达。

m-921.translation: I ran three marathons and my legs are completely weak.

errors.note: “腿都软了”是口语化夸张说法，译成“completely weak”偏生硬、书面，不够像字幕口语，可用“my legs turned to jelly”之类更自然的表达。

m-926.translation: What time did the boss say we have to work overtime until?

m-923.translation: I want to install smart home devices at home, but I've heard that devices from different brands may be incompatible. How should I choose to avoid this problem?

m-927.translation: I followed an influencer's tutorial to prepare a surprise for my girlfriend, but she got angry.

m-918.translation: Don't worry, I'll treat this as a serious matter this time.

m-928.translation: Alright, I'll talk to him in a bit.

m-922.translation: If you don't submit this assignment again, I'll tell the teacher.

errors.note: “再不交”意为“如果还不交/仍不交”，不是“再次提交”，译文把条件句意思完全译错，观众会得到错误信息。

m-929.translation: Who wins in a looks contest: your crush or your best friend?

errors.note: “你心动”指“你心动的人/你喜欢的对象”，译成“your crush”尚可，但原文“你心动”更接近“你心动的对象”，此处基本可接受；真正问题在于“颜值”被译为“looks contest”，见下条。
原文是“颜值谁更胜一筹”，比较的是颜值高低，译文改成“looks contest（选美比赛）”略有增译和语义偏移，但大意仍可理解。

m-920.translation: I secretly brought five phones to class and took turns playing games on them.

m-930.translation: I thought it was a monologue, but it turned out to be narration.

m-932.translation: You didn't say earlier! You're way too good at hiding it!

errors.note: 语气偏生硬、像陈述句，缺少原文“我去”那种惊讶/抱怨的口语感叹语气，不够像字幕口语。

m-933.translation: Because you've gone from being the main character on campus to a bystander.

m-935.translation: What should I do if I'm being manipulated by my boss and still have to keep working overtime?

m-931.translation: Can you still keep studying in this condition?

m-934.translation: I can't believe you didn't say so earlier—I missed the first release.

errors.span: I can't believe you didn't say so earlier
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语感叹，译文改写成“I can't believe you didn't say so earlier”，语气略有加强，但基本意思保留，属轻微偏差。
“首发”在影视/产品语境常指“首映/首发”，译作“the first release”可理解，但略生硬，不够口语化。

m-936.translation: Have you heard of the Shanghai Bund shock?

errors.note: “沪爷”是网络俚语，指上海本地人/上海爷叔，并非“上海外滩”（Shanghai Bund），误译了核心词。
“shock”直译生硬，作为口语化字幕不够自然，且“沪爷冲击”是网络梗，宜保留梗感。

m-938.translation: I wish you'd told me earlier—I'm already seeing little people dancing.

errors.span: I wish you'd told me earlier
errors.note: “我去不早说”是口语化的抱怨/惊讶，译成“I wish you'd told me earlier”偏书面、语气偏弱，不够像字幕口语。

m-937.translation: I can't take it anymore, it's too shocking.

errors.note: “我不行了”在此语境是感叹“我受不了了/太震撼了”的夸张反应，译成“I can't take it anymore”容易被理解为无法忍受、要放弃，语气和含义有偏差。
“too shocking”偏书面且略带负面，口语字幕中“so shocking/so amazing”更自然，语气不够贴合原文的惊叹。

m-939.translation: I've been working for two years and am thinking about changing jobs, but in interviews I'm always asked "Why are you leaving your job?" How should I answer this question better?

m-944.translation: Why did you steal my kill?

m-943.translation: Treat it as a big deal, and don't forget to bring a gift.

m-940.translation: Emma, I can't take it anymore, so beautiful it's breathtaking.

errors.note: “艾玛”是感叹词（相当于“哎呀/天哪”），不是人名 Emma，误译改变了说话对象。
直译“美到窒息”偏书面生硬，字幕口语中不够自然。

m-945.translation: With this budget, it is recommended to choose a Wi-Fi 6 router for better signal coverage and stability.

m-946.translation: You can agree to meet once a month to inject freshness into the relationship.

m-941.translation: So what? Who cares? These two paired together are absolutely perfect—it's maxed-out comedic effect.

errors.span: These two paired together are absolutely perfect
errors.note: “配一起绝了”是口语化赞叹两人搭配效果绝妙，译文译成“absolutely perfect”改变了语气和含义，且“These two paired together”生硬。
“maxed-out comedic effect”生硬不自然，不像字幕口语，宜用“the comedic effect is off the charts”之类。
“谁理你”意为“谁搭理你/谁在乎你”，译成“Who cares?”（谁在乎）语义略有偏差。

m-942.translation: The blogger shared campus funny content, and "that thing of yours really isn't suitable for me to use" — this meme is way too real.

errors.span: that thing of yours really isn't suitable for me to use
errors.note: “你那根”是带性暗示的粗俗双关（指男性器官），译文泛化成“that thing of yours”丢失了原文的荤梗和笑点，导致“这个梗过于真实”的评论失去依托。
生硬的中式英语搭配，英语字幕一般说 funny campus content / campus comedy content。

errors.span: this meme is way too real
errors.note: “梗”在此指搞笑桥段/段子，译成 meme 略偏，且整体语气偏书面，不够字幕口语化。

m-947.translation: I want to create a group for venting about celebrity obsessions and emo moments. We can talk about idols or just go crazy. Only accepting girls born after 2000.

errors.note: “00后”指2000年代出生的人（2000–2009），译成“born after 2000”会错误地包含2010年后出生的人。

errors.span: venting about celebrity obsessions and emo moments
errors.note: “追星emo发泄群”是一个用于追星和发泄情绪的群，译文把“emo”处理成“emo moments”，读起来生硬，也不像自然的字幕口语。

m-948.translation: Watching that video on the homepage where the celebrity said she's a size 36.5 but then got exposed—I'm laughing so hard I can't take it.

errors.note: 36码半指中国/欧洲鞋码36.5，直译为“size 36.5”在英文中会被理解为美码36.5，造成误导，应译为“a Chinese size 36.5”或“an EU size 36.5”。

errors.span: I'm laughing so hard I can't take it
errors.note: “笑得我不行了”是口语化表达，译文略显生硬，用“I can't stop laughing”或“I'm dying laughing”更自然。

m-950.translation: Crying cat meme.jpg, it's so hard for people who mishear lyrics.

errors.note: “空耳”指把歌词听成发音相近的其他词（mondegreen），译文“people who mishear lyrics”只表达了“听错歌词”，丢失了“空耳”这一网络用语特有的趣味含义，但大意尚可理解。

errors.span: it's so hard for people who mishear lyrics
errors.note: “太难了”是口语化吐槽，译文用“it's so hard for...”偏书面、生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-949.translation: Why do I get limited reach every time I post a video?
